::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 167,895 people lived in County Tipperary, up 5.2% on 2016. It had the 7th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 39% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Tipperary was €1,078, the 23rd highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Tipperary

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Tipperary was €30,654, the 5th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Tipperary was €273,900, the 19th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 4.8 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Tipperary, the 15th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 25% of households in County Tipperary rented their home, the 12th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 14% of people living in County Tipperary were born outside Ireland, the third lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 43% of people aged 3 and over in County Tipperary said they could speak Irish, the 6th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 27% of people at work in County Tipperary worked from home for at least part of the week, the 19th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 78% of people travelling to work in County Tipperary went by car, the 4th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Tipperary live more than 2.7 km by road from a GP, the 10th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Tipperary live more than 33.7 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 7th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 11.8% of County Tipperary in 2021, the 8th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
